Row 1: Tangled.Result: **Locked up.** Neither fighter can move or attack anyone else until the end of the round. They can still attack each other
**Shoved apart.** Each is pushed 1 inch straight away from the other. The active fighter must spend an action to close the gap if they want to keep fighting
**Swap.** The fighters spin round each other and trade places
**Headlock.** The active fighter hauls the other round. The active player moves both fighters up to 1 inch in the same direction, still in base contact (forced movement, section 5.5)
**Trip.** A boot goes in. Each player rolls their fighter's **Grit** against the other's (an opposed roll, section 3.4). The loser falls prone; a tie changes nothing
**Pile-on.** Each fighter's nearest ally within 3 inches may step up to 2 inches toward them, into base contact if it reaches

Row 2: Scramble.Result: **Roll for cover.** Both fighters roll into the nearest cover within 3 inches (the active player picks if two are as near), ending in base contact. With no cover in reach, both are **Flustered**
**Rolling fight.** Each player rolls a d6; the higher roll wins the scramble and takes Press (a tie changes nothing)
**The sloppy one.** The fighter with the lower Fight trips and falls prone (a tie: both fall prone)
**Elbows and knees.** Each fighter gains Winded
**Dirty trick.** The active fighter makes a **Routine (6) Nerve** test: on a success the other fighter is **Shook**; on a failure the active fighter is
**Dance.** Each player may move their fighter up to 2 inches while staying in base contact. They may end in different cover

Row 3: Gear.Result: **Sparks.** Each fighter's battery loses 1 Energy as the weapons arc
**Wrong hands.** In the tangle, both fighters switch to their other set of Hands items, even an empty one. Changing back is a Use action (section 7.1). A Fourhands, with both sets in use, keeps them

**The voices shout.** Both fighters' gear speaks at once: each fighter with a voiced device rolls on their crew's voice table now (section 8.5), free, and the result happens. It does not use their ask. A result that works on "this roll" works on their next roll of their own
**Plates settle.** The armour catches and sits right: each fighter wearing armour is **Under warranty**
**Static discharge.** Each fighter's battery gains 1 Energy, up to its size
**Cell trouble.** The fighter with more Energy in their battery loses 1 Energy and the other gains 1 (a tie: nothing)

Row 4: The room.Result: **Dust-up.** Dust and steam fill a cloud 2 inches across around the pair, like a small smoke grenade (it clears as a cloud does, section 7.6): nobody inside can see out, or be seen
**Everyone stops to look.** Every other fighter within 6 inches of the pair, friend or foe, is **Flustered**. With nobody there, the pair are **Flustered** instead
**Something falls.** The nearest other fighter within 4 inches, friend or foe, is knocked prone unless they spend their reaction to Dive. With nobody there, both fighters are **Shook** (the dust)
**Noise.** Starting with the attacker's player, each player may move one other fighter of their own up to 2 inches
**Barked orders.** The nearest other fighter of each side within 6 inches of the pair, if any, is **Hyped**

Row 5: Spectacle.Result: **Trash talk.** Each player shouts one line for their fighter and rolls a d6. The higher roller's fighter is **Hyped** (a tie: neither)
**Underdog's break.** The fighter whose side has fewer fighters standing is **Hyped** (a tie: neither)

**Into the scenery.** The pair crash into whatever is nearest. Both fighters are shoved together in the same direction, toward the nearest wall, locked door or terrain piece within 4 inches (the active player picks if two are as near), until the front one stops against it. With nothing in reach they only stumble: both are **Flustered**

**Stray shot.** "Somebody, somewhere, fired." The nearest other fighter within 6 inches of the pair, friend or foe, takes a **glance** (their save applies). With nobody there, it whines off a wall and nothing happens

**Swap states.** "The gate turns over in its sleep." The two fighters trade states: each takes every state the other holds (Hyped, Shook, Flustered, Under warranty, Announced). With none, nothing happens

**Swinging load.** A chain, a crane arm, a signboard. Each player rolls a d6; the **lower** roller's fighter is knocked 2 inches in a direction the other player chooses, and falls prone (a tie: it misses)

Row 6: The odd ones.Result: **Mutual respect.** Both fighters step 2 inches away from each other, ending out of contact
**Fall back.** The fighter who was attacked may step up to 2 inches away, out of contact, with no parting blow, or stay
**Double fumble.** Each fighter rolls on the Glance table (it is a hit; saves apply)
**The big one.** Each fighter rolls on the Solid table (it is a hit; saves apply)
**One falls for it.** Each player rolls a d6. The lower roller's fighter rolls on the Glance table (a tie: neither)
**Again!** The two fighters fight another exchange at once, rolled from scratch (a second clash in the repeat is read as 62)
